ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ طسٓ تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَكِتَابٍ مُّبِينٍ
en: (1) Ṭā, Seen.[1071] These are the verses of the Qur’ān [i.e., recitation] and a clear Book
tr: Ṭā sīn, tilka āyātul-qurʾāni wakitābim mubīn

ar: هُدًى وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
en: (2) As guidance and good tidings for the believers
tr: Hudaw wabushrā lil-muʾminīn

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ
en: (3) Who establish prayer and give zakāh, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith].
tr: Al-ladhīna yuqīmūnaṣ-ṣalāta wayuʾtūnaz-zakāta wahum bil-ākhirati hum yūqinūn

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ زَيَّنَّا لَهُمْ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَهُمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
en: (4) Indeed, for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have made pleasing to them their deeds, so they wander blindly.
tr: Innal-ladhīna lā yuʾminūna bil-ākhirati zayyannā lahum aʿmālahum fahum yaʿmahūn

ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَهُمْ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ وَهُمْ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمُ ٱلْأَخْسَرُونَ
en: (5) Those are the ones for whom there will be the worst of punishment, and in the Hereafter they are the greatest losers.
tr: Ulāʾikal-ladhīna lahum sūʾul-ʿadhābi wahum fil-ākhirati humul-akhsarūn

ar: وَإِنَّكَ لَتُلَقَّى ٱلْقُرْءَانَ مِن لَّدُنْ حَكِيمٍ عَلِيمٍ
en: (6) And indeed, [O Muḥammad], you receive the Qur’ān from one Wise and Knowing.
tr: Waʾinnaka latulaqqal-qurʾāna mil ladun ḥakīmin ʿalīm

ar: إِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِأَهْلِهِۦٓ إِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًا سَـَٔاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِخَبَرٍ أَوْ ءَاتِيكُم بِشِهَابٍ قَبَسٍ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَصْطَلُونَ
en: (7) [Mention] when Moses said to his family, "Indeed, I have perceived a fire. I will bring you from there information or will bring you a burning torch that you may warm yourselves."
tr: Idh qāla mūsā liʾahlihī innī ānastu nārā, saʾātīkum minhā bikhabarin aw ātīkum bishihābin qabasil laʿallakum taṣṭalūn

ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهَا نُودِىَ أَنۢ بُورِكَ مَن فِى ٱلنَّارِ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
en: (8) But when he came to it, he was called, "Blessed is whoever is at the fire and whoever is around it. And exalted is Allāh, Lord of the worlds.
tr: Falammā jāʾahā nūdiya am būrika man fin-nāri waman ḥawlahā, wasubḥānallāhi rabbil-ʿālamīn

ar: يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
en: (9) O Moses, indeed it is I - Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise."
tr: Yāmūsā innahū anallāhul-ʿazīzul-ḥakīm

ar: وَأَلْقِ عَصَاكَ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهَا تَهْتَزُّ كَأَنَّهَا جَآنٌّ وَلَّىٰ مُدْبِرًا وَلَمْ يُعَقِّبْ يَٰمُوسَىٰ لَا تَخَفْ إِنِّى لَا يَخَافُ لَدَىَّ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
en: (10) And [he was told], "Throw down your staff." But when he saw it writhing as if it were a snake, he turned in flight and did not return.[1072] [Allāh said], "O Moses, fear not. Indeed, in My presence the messengers do not fear.
tr: Waʾalqi ʿaṣāk, falammā raʾāhā tahtazzu kaʾannahā jānnuw wallā mudbiraw walam yuʿaqqib, yāmūsā lā takhaf, innī lā yakhāfu ladayyal-mursalūn

ar: إِلَّا مَن ظَلَمَ ثُمَّ بَدَّلَ حُسْنًۢا بَعْدَ سُوٓءٍ فَإِنِّى غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
en: (11) Otherwise, he who wrongs, then substitutes good after evil - indeed, I am Forgiving and Merciful.
tr: Illā man ẓalama thumma baddala ḥusnam baʿda sūʾin faʾinnī ghafūrur raḥīm

ar: وَأَدْخِلْ يَدَكَ فِى جَيْبِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوٓءٍ فِى تِسْعِ ءَايَٰتٍ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَقَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا فَٰسِقِينَ
en: (12) And put your hand into the opening of your garment [at the breast]; it will come out white without disease. [These are] among the nine signs [you will take] to Pharaoh and his people. Indeed, they have been a people defiantly disobedient."
tr: Waʾadkhil yadaka fī jaybika takhruj bayḍāʾa min ghayri sūʾin fī tisʿi āyātin ilā firʿawna waqawmih, innahum kānū qawman fāsiqīn

ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْهُمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا مُبْصِرَةً قَالُوا۟ هَٰذَا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
en: (13) But when there came to them Our visible signs, they said, "This is obvious magic."
tr: Falammā jāʾathum āyātunā mubṣiratan qālū hādhā siḥrum mubīn

ar: وَجَحَدُوا۟ بِهَا وَٱسْتَيْقَنَتْهَآ أَنفُسُهُمْ ظُلْمًا وَعُلُوًّا فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
en: (14) And they rejected them, while their [inner] selves were convinced thereof, out of injustice and haughtiness. So see how was the end of the corrupters.
tr: Wajaḥadū bihā wastayqanathā anfusuhum ẓulmaw waʿuluwwā, fanẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatul-mufsidīn

ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا دَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَٰنَ عِلْمًا وَقَالَا ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى فَضَّلَنَا عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍ مِّنْ عِبَادِهِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
en: (15) And We had certainly given to David and Solomon knowledge, and they said, "Praise [is due] to Allāh, who has favored us over many of His believing servants."
tr: Walaqad ātaynā dāwūda wasulaymāna ʿilmā, waqālal-ḥamdu lillāhil-ladhī faḍḍalanā ʿalā kathīrim min ʿibādihil-muʾminīn

ar: وَوَرِثَ سُلَيْمَٰنُ دَاوُۥدَ وَقَالَ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ عُلِّمْنَا مَنطِقَ ٱلطَّيْرِ وَأُوتِينَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْفَضْلُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
en: (16) And Solomon inherited David. He said, "O people, we have been taught the language of birds, and we have been given from all things. Indeed, this is evident bounty."
tr: Wawaritha sulaymānu dāwūda waqāla yā ayyuhan-nāsu ʿullimnā manṭiqaṭ-ṭayri waʾūtīnā min kulli shayʾ, inna hādhā lahuwal-faḍlul-mubīn

ar: وَحُشِرَ لِسُلَيْمَٰنَ جُنُودُهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ وَٱلطَّيْرِ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ
en: (17) And gathered for Solomon were his soldiers of the jinn and men and birds, and they were [marching] in rows
tr: Waḥushira lisulaymāna junūduhū minal-jinni wal-insi waṭ-ṭayri fahum yūzaʿūn

ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَتَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ وَادِ ٱلنَّمْلِ قَالَتْ نَمْلَةٌ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّمْلُ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ مَسَٰكِنَكُمْ لَا يَحْطِمَنَّكُمْ سُلَيْمَٰنُ وَجُنُودُهُۥ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
en: (18) Until, when they came upon the valley of the ants, an ant said, "O ants, enter your dwellings that you not be crushed by Solomon and his soldiers while they perceive not."
tr: Ḥattā idhā ataw ʿalā wādin-namli qālat namlatuy yā ayyuhan-namludkhulū masākinakum, lā yaḥṭimannakum sulaymānu wajunūduhū wahum lā yashʿurūn

ar: فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكًا مِّن قَوْلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِىٓ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَىَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَٰلِحًا تَرْضَىٰهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِى بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِى عِبَادِكَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
en: (19) So [Solomon] smiled, amused at her speech, and said, "My Lord, enable me[1073] to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve. And admit me by Your mercy into [the ranks of] Your righteous servants."[1074]
enNotes:
[1073]- More literally, "gather within me the utmost strength and ability."
[1074]- Or "with Your righteous servants [into Paradise]."
tr: Fatabassama ḍāḥikam min qawlihā waqāla rabbi awziʿnī an ashkura niʿmatakal-latī anʿamta ʿalayya waʿalā wālidayya waʾan aʿmala ṣāliḥan tarḍāhu waʾadkhilnī biraḥmatika fī ʿibādikaṣ-ṣāliḥīn

ar: وَتَفَقَّدَ ٱلطَّيْرَ فَقَالَ مَا لِىَ لَآ أَرَى ٱلْهُدْهُدَ أَمْ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْغَآئِبِينَ
en: (20) And he took attendance of the birds and said, "Why do I not see the hoopoe - or is he among the absent?
tr: Watafaqqadaṭ-ṭayra faqāla mā liya lā aral-hudhud, am kāna minal-ghāʾibīn

ar: لَأُعَذِّبَنَّهُۥ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا أَوْ لَأَا۟ذْبَحَنَّهُۥٓ أَوْ لَيَأْتِيَنِّى بِسُلْطَٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
en: (21) I will surely punish him with a severe punishment or slaughter him unless he brings me clear authorization."[1075]
tr: Laʾuʿadhdhibannahū ʿadhāban shadīdan aw laʾadhbaḥannahū aw layaʾtiyannī bisulṭānim mubīn

ar: فَمَكَثَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ فَقَالَ أَحَطتُ بِمَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِۦ وَجِئْتُكَ مِن سَبَإٍۭ بِنَبَإٍ يَقِينٍ
en: (22) But he [i.e., the hoopoe] stayed not long and said, "I have encompassed [in knowledge] that which you have not encompassed, and I have come to you from Sheba with certain news.
tr: Famakatha ghayra baʿīdin faqāla aḥaṭtu bimā lam tuḥiṭ bihī wajiʾtuka min sabaʾim binabaʾiy yaqīn

ar: إِنِّى وَجَدتُّ ٱمْرَأَةً تَمْلِكُهُمْ وَأُوتِيَتْ مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَلَهَا عَرْشٌ عَظِيمٌ
en: (23) Indeed, I found [there] a woman ruling them, and she has been given of all things, and she has a great throne.
tr: Innī wajattumraʾatan tamlikuhum waʾūtiyat min kulli shayʾiw walahā ʿarshun ʿaẓīm

ar: وَجَدتُّهَا وَقَوْمَهَا يَسْجُدُونَ لِلشَّمْسِ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ فَهُمْ لَا يَهْتَدُونَ
en: (24) I found her and her people prostrating to the sun instead of Allāh, and Satan has made their deeds pleasing to them and averted them from [His] way, so they are not guided,
tr: Wajattuhā waqawmahā yasjudūna lish-shamsi min dūnillāhi wazayyana lahumush-shayṭānu aʿmālahum faṣaddahum ʿanis-sabīli fahum lā yahtadūn

ar: أَلَّا يَسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى يُخْرِجُ ٱلْخَبْءَ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُخْفُونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ
en: (25) [And] so they do not prostrate to Allāh, who brings forth what is hidden within the heavens and the earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare -
tr: Allā yasjudū lillāhil-ladhī yukhrijul-khabʾa fis-samāwāti wal-arḍi wayaʿlamu mā tukhfūna wamā tuʿlinūn

ar: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
en: (26) Allāh - there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Great Throne."
tr: Allāhu lā ilāha illā huwa rabbul-ʿarshil-ʿaẓīm

ar: قَالَ سَنَنظُرُ أَصَدَقْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
en: (27) [Solomon] said, "We will see whether you were truthful or were of the liars.
tr: Qāla sananẓuru aṣadaqta am kunta minal-kādhibīn

ar: ٱذْهَب بِّكِتَٰبِى هَٰذَا فَأَلْقِهْ إِلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا يَرْجِعُونَ
en: (28) Take this letter of mine and deliver it to them. Then leave them and see what [answer] they will return."
tr: Idhhab bikitābī hādhā faʾalqih ilayhim thumma tawalla ʿanhum fanẓur mādhā yarjiʿūn

ar: قَالَتْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ إِنِّىٓ أُلْقِىَ إِلَىَّ كِتَٰبٌ كَرِيمٌ
en: (29) She said, "O eminent ones, indeed, to me has been delivered a noble letter.
tr: Qālat yā ayyuhal-malaʾu innī ulqiya ilayya kitābun karīm

ar: إِنَّهُۥ مِن سُلَيْمَٰنَ وَإِنَّهُۥ بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
en: (30) Indeed, it is from Solomon, and indeed, it is [i.e., reads]: 'In the name of Allāh, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,
tr: Innahū min sulaymāna waʾinnahū bismillāhir-raḥmānir-raḥīm

ar: أَلَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَىَّ وَأْتُونِى مُسْلِمِينَ
en: (31) Be not haughty with me but come to me in submission [as Muslims].'"
tr: Allā taʿlū ʿalayya waʾtūnī muslimīn

ar: قَالَتْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ أَفْتُونِى فِىٓ أَمْرِى مَا كُنتُ قَاطِعَةً أَمْرًا حَتَّىٰ تَشْهَدُونِ
en: (32) She said, "O eminent ones, advise me in my affair. I would not decide a matter until you witness [for] me."[1076]
enNotes: [1076]- i.e., are present with me or testify in my favor.
tr: Qālat yā ayyuhal-malaʾu aftūnī fī amrī, mā kuntu qāṭiʿatan amran ḥattā tashhadūn

ar: قَالُوا۟ نَحْنُ أُو۟لُوا۟ قُوَّةٍ وَأُو۟لُوا۟ بَأْسٍ شَدِيدٍ وَٱلْأَمْرُ إِلَيْكِ فَٱنظُرِى مَاذَا تَأْمُرِينَ
en: (33) They said, "We are men of strength and of great military might, but the command is yours, so see what you will command."
tr: Qālū naḥnu ulū quwwatiw waʾulū baʾsin shadīdiw wal-amru ilayki fanẓurī mādhā taʾmurīn

ar: قَالَتْ إِنَّ ٱلْمُلُوكَ إِذَا دَخَلُوا۟ قَرْيَةً أَفْسَدُوهَا وَجَعَلُوٓا۟ أَعِزَّةَ أَهْلِهَآ أَذِلَّةً وَكَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
en: (34) She said, "Indeed kings - when they enter a city, they ruin it and render the honored of its people humbled. And thus do they do.
tr: Qālat innal-mulūka idhā dakhalū qaryatan afsadūhā wajaʿalū aʿizzata ahlihā adhillah, wakadhālika yafʿalūn

ar: وَإِنِّى مُرْسِلَةٌ إِلَيْهِم بِهَدِيَّةٍ فَنَاظِرَةٌۢ بِمَ يَرْجِعُ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
en: (35) But indeed, I will send to them a gift and see with what [reply] the messengers will return."
tr: Waʾinnī mursilatun ilayhim bihadiyyatin fanāẓiratum bima yarjiʿul-mursalūn

ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ سُلَيْمَٰنَ قَالَ أَتُمِدُّونَنِ بِمَالٍ فَمَآ ءَاتَىٰنِۦَ ٱللَّهُ خَيْرٌ مِّمَّآ ءَاتَىٰكُم بَلْ أَنتُم بِهَدِيَّتِكُمْ تَفْرَحُونَ
en: (36) So when they came to Solomon, he said, "Do you provide me with wealth? But what Allāh has given me is better than what He has given you. Rather, it is you who rejoice in your gift.
tr: Falammā jāʾa sulaymāna qāla atumiddūnani bimālin famā ātānillāhu khayrum mimmā ātākum, bal antum bihadiyyatikum tafraḥūn

ar: ٱرْجِعْ إِلَيْهِمْ فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّهُم بِجُنُودٍ لَّا قِبَلَ لَهُم بِهَا وَلَنُخْرِجَنَّهُم مِّنْهَآ أَذِلَّةً وَهُمْ صَٰغِرُونَ
en: (37) Return to them, for we will surely come to them with soldiers that they will be powerless to encounter, and we will surely expel them therefrom in humiliation, and they will be debased."
tr: Irjiʿ ilayhim falanaʾtiyannahum bijunūdil lā qibala lahum bihā walanukhrijannahum minhā adhillataw wahum ṣāghirūn

ar: قَالَ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ أَيُّكُمْ يَأْتِينِى بِعَرْشِهَا قَبْلَ أَن يَأْتُونِى مُسْلِمِينَ
en: (38) [Solomon] said, "O assembly [of jinn], which of you will bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?"
tr: Qāla yā ayyuhal-malaʾu ayyukum yaʾtīnī biʿarshihā qabla ay yaʾtūnī muslimīn

ar: قَالَ عِفْرِيتٌ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ أَنَا۠ ءَاتِيكَ بِهِۦ قَبْلَ أَن تَقُومَ مِن مَّقَامِكَ وَإِنِّى عَلَيْهِ لَقَوِىٌّ أَمِينٌ
en: (39) A powerful one from among the jinn said, "I will bring it to you before you rise from your place, and indeed, I am for this [task] strong and trustworthy."
tr: Qāla ʿifrītum minal-jinni ana ātīka bihī qabla an taqūma mim maqāmik, waʾinnī ʿalayhi laqawiyyun amīn

ar: قَالَ ٱلَّذِى عِندَهُۥ عِلْمٌ مِّنَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ أَنَا۠ ءَاتِيكَ بِهِۦ قَبْلَ أَن يَرْتَدَّ إِلَيْكَ طَرْفُكَ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهُ مُسْتَقِرًّا عِندَهُۥ قَالَ هَٰذَا مِن فَضْلِ رَبِّى لِيَبْلُوَنِىٓ ءَأَشْكُرُ أَمْ أَكْفُرُ وَمَن شَكَرَ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ رَبِّى غَنِىٌّ كَرِيمٌ
en: (40) Said one who had knowledge from the Scripture, "I will bring it to you before your glance returns to you." And when [Solomon] saw it placed before him, he said, "This is from the favor of my Lord to test me whether I will be grateful or ungrateful. And whoever is grateful - his gratitude is only for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever is ungrateful - then indeed, my Lord is Free of need and Generous."
tr: Qālal-ladhī ʿindahū ʿilmum minal-kitābi ana ātīka bihī qabla ay yartadda ilayka ṭarfuk, falammā raʾāhu mustaqirran ʿindahū qāla hādhā min faḍli rabbī, liyabluwanī aʾashkuru am akfur, waman shakara faʾinnamā yashkuru linafsih, waman kafara faʾinna rabbī ghaniyyun karīm

ar: قَالَ نَكِّرُوا۟ لَهَا عَرْشَهَا نَنظُرْ أَتَهْتَدِىٓ أَمْ تَكُونُ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَهْتَدُونَ
en: (41) He said, "Disguise for her her throne; we will see whether she will be guided [to truth] or will be of those who is not guided."
tr: Qāla nakkirū lahā ʿarshahā nanẓur atahtadī am takūnu minal-ladhīna lā yahtadūn

ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
en: (42) So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh].
tr: Falammā jāʾat qīla ahākadhā ʿarshuk, qālat kaʾannahū huw, waʾūtīnal-ʿilma min qablihā wakunnā muslimīn

ar: وَصَدَّهَا مَا كَانَت تَّعْبُدُ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِنَّهَا كَانَتْ مِن قَوْمٍ كَٰفِرِينَ
en: (43) And that which she was worshipping other than Allāh had averted her [from submission to Him]. Indeed, she was from a disbelieving people."
tr: Waṣaddahā mā kānat taʿbudu min dūnillāh, innahā kānat min qawmin kāfirīn

ar: قِيلَ لَهَا ٱدْخُلِى ٱلصَّرْحَ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةً وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ صَرْحٌ مُّمَرَّدٌ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَٰنَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
en: (44) She was told, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water[1077] and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allāh, Lord of the worlds."
enNotes: [1077]- The floor was transparent, and beneath it was flowing water.
tr: Qīla lahadkhuliṣ-ṣarḥ, falammā raʾathu ḥasibathu lujjataw wakashafat ʿan sāqayhā, qāla innahū ṣarḥum mumarradum min qawārīr, qālat rabbi innī ẓalamtu nafsī waʾaslamtu maʿa sulaymāna lillāhi rabbil-ʿālamīn

ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
en: (45) And We had certainly sent to Thamūd their brother Ṣāliḥ, [saying], "Worship Allāh," and at once they were two parties conflicting.
tr: Walaqad arsalnā ilā thamūda akhāhum ṣāliḥan aniʿbudullāha faʾidhā hum farīqāni yakhtaṣimūn

ar: قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ لِمَ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ قَبْلَ ٱلْحَسَنَةِ لَوْلَا تَسْتَغْفِرُونَ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
en: (46) He said, "O my people, why are you impatient for evil before [i.e., instead of] good?[1078] Why do you not seek forgiveness of Allāh that you may receive mercy?"
enNotes: [1078]- By challenging Ṣāliḥ to bring on the promised punishment rather than asking for mercy from Allāh.
tr: Qāla yāqawmi lima tastaʿjilūna bis-sayyiʾati qablal-ḥasanah, lawlā tastaghfirūnallāha laʿallakum turḥamūn

ar: قَالُوا۟ ٱطَّيَّرْنَا بِكَ وَبِمَن مَّعَكَ قَالَ طَٰٓئِرُكُمْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ تُفْتَنُونَ
en: (47) They said, "We consider you a bad omen, you and those with you." He said, "Your omen [i.e., fate] is with Allāh. Rather, you are a people being tested."[1079]
tr: Qāluṭṭayyarnā bika wabimam maʿak, qāla ṭāʾirukum ʿindallāhi bal antum qawmun tuftanūn

ar: وَكَانَ فِى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ تِسْعَةُ رَهْطٍ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ
en: (48) And there were in the city nine family heads causing corruption in the land and not amending [its affairs].
tr: Wakāna fil-madīnati tisʿatu rahṭiy yufsidūna fil-arḍi walā yuṣliḥūn

ar: قَالُوا۟ تَقَاسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ لَنُبَيِّتَنَّهُۥ وَأَهْلَهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَقُولَنَّ لِوَلِيِّهِۦ مَا شَهِدْنَا مَهْلِكَ أَهْلِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَصَٰدِقُونَ
en: (49) They said, "Take a mutual oath by Allāh that we will kill him by night, he and his family. Then we will say to his executor,[1080] 'We did not witness the destruction of his family, and indeed, we are truthful.'"
enNotes: [1080]- i.e., the one responsible for executing his will and avenging his blood.
tr: Qālū taqāsamū billāhi lanubayyitannahū waʾahlahū thumma lanaqūlanna liwaliyyihī mā shahidnā mahlika ahlihī waʾinnā laṣādiqūn

ar: وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًا وَمَكَرْنَا مَكْرًا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
en: (50) And they planned a plan, and We planned a plan, while they perceived not.
tr: Wamakarū makraw wamakarnā makraw wahum lā yashʿurūn

ar: فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ مَكْرِهِمْ أَنَّا دَمَّرْنَٰهُمْ وَقَوْمَهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
en: (51) Then look how was the outcome of their plan - that We destroyed them and their people, all.
tr: Fanẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu makrihim annā dammarnāhum waqawmahum ajmaʿīn

ar: فَتِلْكَ بُيُوتُهُمْ خَاوِيَةًۢ بِمَا ظَلَمُوٓا۟ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ
en: (52) So those are their houses, desolate because of the wrong they had done. Indeed in that is a sign for people who know.
tr: Fatilka buyūtuhum khāwiyatam bimā ẓalamū, inna fī dhālika laʾāyatal liqawmiy yaʿlamūn

ar: وَأَنجَيْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ يَتَّقُونَ
en: (53) And We saved those who believed and used to fear Allāh.
tr: Waʾanjaynal-ladhīna āmanū wakānū yattaqūn

ar: وَلُوطًا إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ أَتَأْتُونَ ٱلْفَٰحِشَةَ وَأَنتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ
en: (54) And [mention] Lot, when he said to his people, "Do you commit immorality[1081] while you are seeing?[1082]
enNotes:
[1081]- Homosexual acts.
[1082]- i.e., openly. Another meaning is "...while you are aware [that it is wrong]."
tr: Walūṭan idh qāla liqawmihī ataʾtūnal-fāḥishata waʾantum tubṣirūn

ar: أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ ٱلرِّجَالَ شَهْوَةً مِّن دُونِ ٱلنِّسَآءِ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ تَجْهَلُونَ
en: (55) Do you indeed approach men with desire instead of women? Rather, you are a people behaving ignorantly."
tr: Aʾinnakum lataʾtūnar-rijāla shahwatam min dūnin-nisāʾ, bal antum qawmun tajhalūn

ar: فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوٓا۟ أَخْرِجُوٓا۟ ءَالَ لُوطٍ مِّن قَرْيَتِكُمْ إِنَّهُمْ أُنَاسٌ يَتَطَهَّرُونَ
en: (56) But the answer of his people was not except that they said, "Expel the family of Lot from your city. Indeed, they are people who keep themselves pure."
tr: Famā kāna jawāba qawmihī illā an qālū akhrijū āla lūṭim min qaryatikum innahum unāsuy yataṭahharūn

ar: فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَٰهَا مِنَ ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
en: (57) So We saved him and his family, except for his wife; We destined her to be of those who remained behind.
tr: Faʾanjaynāhu waʾahlahū illamraʾatahū qaddarnāhā minal-ghābirīn

ar: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًا فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
en: (58) And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.
tr: Waʾamṭarnā ʿalayhim maṭarā, fasāʾa maṭarul-mundharīn

ar: قُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ عِبَادِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱصْطَفَىٰٓ ءَآللَّهُ خَيْرٌ أَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
en: (59) Say, [O Muḥammad], "Praise be to Allāh, and peace upon His servants whom He has chosen. Is Allāh better or what they associate with Him?"
tr: Qulil-ḥamdu lillāhi wasalāmun ʿalā ʿibādihil-ladhīnaṣṭafā, āllāhu khayrun ammā yushrikūn

ar: أَمَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ حَدَآئِقَ ذَاتَ بَهْجَةٍ مَّا كَانَ لَكُمْ أَن تُنۢبِتُوا۟ شَجَرَهَآ أَءِلَٰهٌ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ يَعْدِلُونَ
en: (60) [More precisely], is He [not best] who created the heavens and the earth and sent down for you rain from the sky, causing to grow thereby gardens of joyful beauty which you could not [otherwise] have grown the trees thereof? Is there a deity with Allāh?[1083] [No], but they are a people who ascribe equals [to Him].
enNotes: [1083]- Three meanings are implied: "Is there another god who did all of this with Allāh?" or "Is there any deity worthy to be worshipped along with Allāh?" or "Is there a deity to be compared with Allāh?"
tr: Amman khalaqas-samāwāti wal-arḍa waʾanzala lakum minas-samāʾi māʾan faʾambatnā bihī ḥadāʾiqa dhāta bahjah, mā kāna lakum an tumbitū shajarahā, aʾilāhum maʿallāh, bal hum qawmuy yaʿdilūn

ar: أَمَّن جَعَلَ ٱلْأَرْضَ قَرَارًا وَجَعَلَ خِلَٰلَهَآ أَنْهَٰرًا وَجَعَلَ لَهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ حَاجِزًا أَءِلَٰهٌ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
en: (61) Is He [not best] who made the earth a stable ground and placed within it rivers and made for it firmly set mountains and placed between the two seas a barrier? Is there a deity with Allāh? [No], but most of them do not know.
tr: Amman jaʿalal-arḍa qarāraw wajaʿala khilālahā anhāraw wajaʿala lahā rawāsiya wajaʿala baynal-baḥrayni ḥājizā, aʾilāhum maʿallāh, bal aktharuhum lā yaʿlamūn

ar: أَمَّن يُجِيبُ ٱلْمُضْطَرَّ إِذَا دَعَاهُ وَيَكْشِفُ ٱلسُّوٓءَ وَيَجْعَلُكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ ٱلْأَرْضِ أَءِلَٰهٌ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
en: (62) Is He [not best] who responds to the desperate one when he calls upon Him and removes evil and makes you inheritors of the earth?[1084] Is there a deity with Allāh? Little do you remember.
tr: Ammay yujībul-muḍṭarra idhā daʿāhu wayakshifus-sūʾa wayajʿalukum khulafāʾal-arḍ, aʾilāhum maʿallāh, qalīlam mā tadhakkarūn

ar: أَمَّن يَهْدِيكُمْ فِى ظُلُمَٰتِ ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ وَمَن يُرْسِلُ ٱلرِّيَٰحَ بُشْرًۢا بَيْنَ يَدَىْ رَحْمَتِهِۦٓ أَءِلَٰهٌ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ تَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
en: (63) Is He [not best] who guides you through the darknesses of the land and sea and who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy? Is there a deity with Allāh? High is Allāh above whatever they associate with Him.
tr: Ammay yahdīkum fī ẓulumātil-barri wal-baḥri wamay yursilur-riyāḥa bushram bayna yaday raḥmatih, aʾilāhum maʿallāh, taʿālallāhu ʿammā yushrikūn

ar: أَمَّن يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ وَمَن يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أَءِلَٰهٌ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ قُلْ هَاتُوا۟ بُرْهَٰنَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
en: (64) Is He [not best] who begins creation and then repeats it and who provides for you from the heaven and earth? Is there a deity with Allāh? Say, "Produce your proof, if you should be truthful."
tr: Ammay yabdaʾul-khalqa thumma yuʿīduhū wamay yarzuqukum minas-samāʾi wal-arḍ, aʾilāhum maʿallāh, qul hātū burhānakum in kuntum ṣādiqīn

ar: قُل لَّا يَعْلَمُ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلْغَيْبَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبْعَثُونَ
en: (65) Say, "None in the heavens and earth knows the unseen except Allāh, and they do not perceive when they will be resurrected."
tr: Qul lā yaʿlamu man fis-samāwāti wal-arḍil-ghayba illallāh, wamā yashʿurūna ayyāna yubʿathūn

ar: بَلِ ٱدَّٰرَكَ عِلْمُهُمْ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّنْهَا بَلْ هُم مِّنْهَا عَمُونَ
en: (66) Rather, their knowledge is arrested concerning the Hereafter. Rather, they are in doubt about it. Rather, they are, concerning it, blind.
tr: Baliddāraka ʿilmuhum fil-ākhirah, bal hum fī shakkim minhā, bal hum minhā ʿamūn

ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا كُنَّا تُرَٰبًا وَءَابَآؤُنَآ أَئِنَّا لَمُخْرَجُونَ
en: (67) And those who disbelieve say, "When we have become dust as well as our forefathers, will we indeed be brought out [of the graves]?
tr: Waqālal-ladhīna kafarū aʾidhā kunnā turābaw waʾābāʾunā aʾinnā lamukhrajūn

ar: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا هَٰذَا نَحْنُ وَءَابَآؤُنَا مِن قَبْلُ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
en: (68) We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before. This is not but legends of the former peoples."
tr: Laqad wuʿidnā hādhā naḥnu waʾābāʾunā min qablu in hādhā illā asāṭīrul-awwalīn

ar: قُلْ سِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
en: (69) Say, [O Muḥammad], "Proceed [i.e., travel] through the land and observe how was the end of the criminals."
tr: Qul sīrū fil-arḍi fanẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatul-mujrimīn

ar: وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا تَكُن فِى ضَيْقٍ مِّمَّا يَمْكُرُونَ
en: (70) And grieve not over them or be in distress from what they conspire.
tr: Walā taḥzan ʿalayhim walā takun fī ḍayqim mimmā yamkurūn

ar: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
en: (71) And they say, "When is [the fulfillment of] this promise, if you should be truthful?"
tr: Wayaqūlūna matā hādhal-waʿdu in kuntum ṣādiqīn

ar: قُلْ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ رَدِفَ لَكُم بَعْضُ ٱلَّذِى تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
en: (72) Say, "Perhaps it is close behind you [i.e., very near] - some of that for which you are impatient.
tr: Qul ʿasā ay yakūna radifa lakum baʿḍul-ladhī tastaʿjilūn

ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ
en: (73) And indeed, your Lord is the possessor of bounty for the people, but most of them are not grateful."
tr: Waʾinna rabbaka ladhū faḍlin ʿalan-nāsi walākinna aktharahum lā yashkurūn

ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُكِنُّ صُدُورُهُمْ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
en: (74) And indeed, your Lord knows what their breasts conceal and what they declare.
tr: Waʾinna rabbaka layaʿlamu mā tukinnu ṣudūruhum wamā yuʿlinūn

ar: وَمَا مِنْ غَآئِبَةٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا فِى كِتَٰبٍ مُّبِينٍ
en: (75) And there is nothing concealed[1085] within the heaven and the earth except that it is in a clear Register.[1086]
enNotes:
[1085]- Literally, "absent [from the senses]."
[1086]- The Preserved Slate (al-Lawḥ al-Maḥfūẓ), which is with Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā).
tr: Wamā min ghāʾibatin fis-samāʾi wal-arḍi illā fī kitābim mubīn

ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ يَقُصُّ عَلَىٰ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ أَكْثَرَ ٱلَّذِى هُمْ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
en: (76) Indeed, this Qur’ān relates to the Children of Israel most of that over which they disagree.
tr: Inna hādhal-qurʾāna yaquṣṣu ʿalā banī isrāʾīla aktharal-ladhī hum fīhi yakhtalifūn

ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
en: (77) And indeed, it is guidance and mercy for the believers.
tr: Waʾinnahū lahudaw waraḥmatul lil-muʾminīn

ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِى بَيْنَهُم بِحُكْمِهِۦ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
en: (78) Indeed, your Lord will judge between them by His [wise] judgement. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
tr: Inna rabbaka yaqḍī baynahum biḥukmih, wahuwal-ʿazīzul-ʿalīm

ar: فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ إِنَّكَ عَلَى ٱلْحَقِّ ٱلْمُبِينِ
en: (79) So rely upon Allāh; indeed, you are upon the clear truth.
tr: Fatawakkal ʿalallāh, innaka ʿalal-ḥaqqil-mubīn

ar: إِنَّكَ لَا تُسْمِعُ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَلَا تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا وَلَّوْا۟ مُدْبِرِينَ
en: (80) Indeed, you will not make the dead hear, nor will you make the deaf hear the call when they have turned their backs retreating.
tr: Innaka lā tusmiʿul-mawtā walā tusmiʿuṣ-ṣummad-duʿāʾa idhā wallaw mudbirīn

ar: وَمَآ أَنتَ بِهَٰدِى ٱلْعُمْىِ عَن ضَلَٰلَتِهِمْ إِن تُسْمِعُ إِلَّا مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَهُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
en: (81) And you cannot guide the blind away from their error. You will only make hear those who believe in Our verses so they are Muslims [i.e., submitting to Allāh].
tr: Wamā anta bihādil-ʿumyi ʿan ḍalālatihim, in tusmiʿu illā may yuʾminu biʾāyātinā fahum muslimūn

ar: وَإِذَا وَقَعَ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَخْرَجْنَا لَهُمْ دَآبَّةً مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ تُكَلِّمُهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلنَّاسَ كَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا لَا يُوقِنُونَ
en: (82) And when the word [i.e., decree] befalls them,[1087] We will bring forth for them a creature from the earth speaking to them, [saying] that the people were, of Our verses, not certain [in faith].
enNotes: [1087]- At the approach of the Hour.
tr: Waʾidhā waqaʿal-qawlu ʿalayhim akhrajnā lahum dābbatam minal-arḍi tukallimuhum annan-nāsa kānū biʾāyātinā lā yūqinūn

ar: وَيَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ فَوْجًا مِّمَّن يُكَذِّبُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ
en: (83) And [warn of] the Day when We will gather from every nation a company of those who deny Our signs, and they will be [driven] in rows
tr: Wayawma naḥshuru min kulli ummatin fawjam mimmay yukadhdhibu biʾāyātinā fahum yūzaʿūn

ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُو قَالَ أَكَذَّبْتُم بِـَٔايَٰتِى وَلَمْ تُحِيطُوا۟ بِهَا عِلْمًا أَمَّاذَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
en: (84) Until, when they arrive [at the place of Judgement], He will say, "Did you deny My signs while you encompassed them not in knowledge, or what [was it that] you were doing?"
tr: Ḥattā idhā jāʾū qāla akadhdhabtum biʾāyātī walam tuḥīṭū bihā ʿilman ammādhā kuntum taʿmalūn

ar: وَوَقَعَ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَيْهِم بِمَا ظَلَمُوا۟ فَهُمْ لَا يَنطِقُونَ
en: (85) And the decree will befall them[1088] for the wrong they did, and they will not [be able to] speak.
enNotes: [1088]- Allāh's decree will come into effect upon them, and His promise will be fulfilled.
tr: Wawaqaʿal-qawlu ʿalayhim bimā ẓalamū fahum lā yanṭiqūn

ar: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا جَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيْلَ لِيَسْكُنُوا۟ فِيهِ وَٱلنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
en: (86) Do they not see that We made the night that they may rest therein and the day giving sight? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
tr: Alam yaraw annā jaʿalnal-layla liyaskunū fīhi wan-nahāra mubṣirā, inna fī dhālika laʾāyātil liqawmiy yuʾminūn

ar: وَيَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَفَزِعَ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ وَكُلٌّ أَتَوْهُ دَٰخِرِينَ
en: (87) And [warn of] the Day the Horn will be blown, and whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth will be terrified except whom Allāh wills. And all will come to Him humbled.
tr: Wayawma yunfakhu fiṣ-ṣūri fafaziʿa man fis-samāwāti waman fil-arḍi illā man shāʾallāh, wakullun atawhu dākhirīn

ar: وَتَرَى ٱلْجِبَالَ تَحْسَبُهَا جَامِدَةً وَهِىَ تَمُرُّ مَرَّ ٱلسَّحَابِ صُنْعَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَتْقَنَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ إِنَّهُۥ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَفْعَلُونَ
en: (88) And you see the mountains, thinking them motionless,[1089] while they will pass as the passing of clouds. [It is] the work of Allāh, who perfected all things. Indeed, He is Aware of that which you do.
tr: Wataral-jibāla taḥsabuhā jāmidataw wahiya tamurru marras-saḥāb, ṣunʿallāhil-ladhī atqana kulla shayʾ, innahū khabīrum bimā tafʿalūn

ar: مَن جَآءَ بِٱلْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُۥ خَيْرٌ مِّنْهَا وَهُم مِّن فَزَعٍ يَوْمَئِذٍ ءَامِنُونَ
en: (89) Whoever comes [at Judgement] with a good deed will have better than it, and they, from the terror of that Day, will be safe.
tr: Man jāʾa bil-ḥasanati falahū khayrum minhā, wahum min fazaʿiy yawmaʾidhin āminūn

ar: وَمَن جَآءَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ فَكُبَّتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ فِى ٱلنَّارِ هَلْ تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
en: (90) And whoever comes with an evil deed[1090] - their faces will be overturned into the Fire, [and it will be said], "Are you recompensed except for what you used to do?"
enNotes: [1090]- Without having repented. It may refer generally to any sin or more specifically to association of another with Allāh.
tr: Waman jāʾa bis-sayyiʾati fakubbat wujūhuhum fin-nār, hal tujzawna illā mā kuntum taʿmalūn

ar: إِنَّمَآ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ رَبَّ هَٰذِهِ ٱلْبَلْدَةِ ٱلَّذِى حَرَّمَهَا وَلَهُۥ كُلُّ شَىْءٍ وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
en: (91) [Say, O Muḥammad], "I have only been commanded to worship the Lord of this city,[1091] who made it sacred and to whom [belongs] all things. And I am commanded to be of the Muslims [i.e., those who submit to Allāh]
enNotes: [1091]- Or region, meaning Makkah and its surroundings.
tr: Innamā umirtu an aʿbuda rabba hādhihil-baldatil-ladhī ḥarramahā walahū kullu shayʾiw waʾumirtu an akūna minal-muslimīn

ar: وَأَنْ أَتْلُوَا۟ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ فَمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِى لِنَفْسِهِۦ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَقُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُنذِرِينَ
en: (92) And to recite the Qur’ān." And whoever is guided is only guided for [the benefit of] himself; and whoever strays - say, "I am only [one] of the warners."
tr: Waʾan atluwal-qurʾān, famanihtadā faʾinnamā yahtadī linafsih, waman ḍalla faqul innamā ana minal-mundhirīn

ar: وَقُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ سَيُرِيكُمْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ فَتَعْرِفُونَهَا وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
en: (93) And say, "[All] praise is [due] to Allāh. He will show you His signs, and you will recognize them. And your Lord is not unaware of what you do."
tr: Waqulil-ḥamdu lillāhi sayurīkum āyātihī fataʿrifūnahā, wamā rabbuka bighāfilin ʿammā taʿmalūn
